newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Power sees 1997 sales at $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Power sees 1997 sales at $400 mln.

text.p: DuPont Power Marketing Inc said Friday it expects sales in the $400 million range this year.

Calling itself one of the nation's fastest growing power marketers, the DuPont Co subsidiary said it reported sales of 4.5 million megawatt-hours of electricity during the second quarter, an increase of more than 1,000 percent over its second quarter 1996 figures.
DuPont Power Marketing said about 60 percent of its electric sales are in the eastern portion of the United States, although a significant portion are within Texas.
DuPont Power Marketing is affiliated with the natural gas and gas liquids operations of another DuPont subsidiary, Conoco Inc.
